intro: The Shipping Schedule is a logistical document held by the Defias Brotherhood's dockmaster at Jerod's Landing. It outlines illicit cargo shipments flowing through Elwynn Forest between Redridge and Westfall, drawing the close attention of Stormwind's intelligence agency.

p: South of Goldshire on the Elwynn bank of the Nazferiti River, the Defias Brotherhood seized control of Jerod's Landing to serve as a hub for their river traffic. Through this covert dock, the Brotherhood moves large quantities of contraband between Redridge and Westfall, slipping through waterways right under the nose of the Stormwind Guard. The Shipping Schedule records these clandestine movements, kept under close guard on the dockmaster's person.

Master Mathias Shaw, leader of SI:7, commissioned the theft of the schedule to map Defias supply chains and test fledgling operatives. Infiltrating the dock house and lifting the document from the dockmaster's pockets serves both as actionable intelligence for the crown and as an initiation trial. If the operative is caught, SI:7 disavows all connection, leaving no trail back to the barracks in Stormwind.
